# crystals/example_H2O_frame0.gro
gmx grompp -f grompp.mdp -c conf.gro -p topol.top -o topol.tpr -maxwarn 5
gmx order -s topol.tpr -f input.gro -n index.ndx -Sg sg.xvg -Sk sk.xvg -o order.xvg -od deuter.xvg  (stdin: "0\n")
#   Group     0 (             OW) has  3000 elements
